limitations: Witness families depend on derivative order; globally bounded and locally analytic but not entire. Exponential cost is specific to this single-estimator and a sequential smoothing-radius then order limit.
scientific_integrity: One-dimensional, finite-phase root-of-unity estimator; exact analytical proof with independent finite arithmetic corroboration. Prior published sufficiency n>=p is acknowledged. No independent audit or general estimator optimality is claimed.
title: Sharp phase-count and order-cost barriers for rotationally symmetric Gaussian derivative estimation
